Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-boost-transcribe-medium-0011", "row_sha256": "ed2ddde075cbe0ca7145fb76864d7fbac27125c187a103b54a7fd13c8c6e782b", "mode": "/transcribe", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Remove true hesitation and accidental restarts. Apply explicit corrections to the final stated intent. Preserve meaningful filler-like words and unfinished thoughts. Apply clearly spoken punctuation and list cues. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "hey i'm setting up the desktop uploader for the field team and i need help checking the profile before i hand it over. use the folder E:\FieldDrop as the local staging folder, not Downloads, sorry, use D:\FieldDrop instead. keep the remote destination /incoming/field. the config key is
transfer.allow_resume
set that to true so a transfer can continue after the connection drops. for the batch settings let it send no more than 6 files at once and make 3 retry attempts after a failed transfer. keep the transfer logs for 14 days, that's retention not a retry delay. i also want the uploader to show a warning before it replaces a file with the same name, but don't make it stop all other uploads. can you give me the exact settings to check in the desktop app, and mention whether the resume option applies to a file that's only partly uploaded. i haven't decided whether to turn on email alerts, so leave that out of the setup for now. wait, call the profile Field intake, not Field team. use Field intake in the profile label. that's all.", "output": "Hey, I'm setting up the desktop uploader for the field team, and I need help checking the profile before I hand it over. Use the folder D:\FieldDrop as the local staging folder. Keep the remote destination /incoming/field. The config key is
transfer.allow_resume
Set that to true so a transfer can continue after the connection drops. For the batch settings, let it send no more than 6 files at once and make 3 retry attempts after a failed transfer. Keep the transfer logs for 14 days; that's retention, not a retry delay. I also want the uploader to show a warning before it replaces a file with the same name, but don't make it stop all other uploads. Can you give me the exact settings to check in the desktop app, and mention whether the resume option applies to a file that's only partly uploaded? I haven't decided whether to turn on email alerts, so leave that out of the setup for now. Call the profile Field intake, not Field team. Use Field intake in the profile label. That's all."}]
